# limen_schema (Data Source)

The JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of one kind's `spec`, generated by the control plane from the same types it parses with.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "limen_schema" "resource" {
  kind = "resource"
}

# The fields a resource spec accepts, as the control plane parses it.
output "resource_targets" {
  value = keys(jsondecode(data.limen_schema.resource.json_schema).properties)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) The kind: one of `role`, `role_mapping`, `resource`, `bot`, `discovery`, `policy_test`, `resource_profile`, `policy_writer`.

### Read-Only

- `json_schema` (String) The schema, as JSON.
- `server_version` (String) The server version it came from.
